visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Medium: Live-action digital video. A young woman with auburn hair styled in two long braids, wearing a light pink hoodie with a cartoon bear graphic, stands against a background of light-colored wooden cabinetry. She holds a silver smartphone, looking at the screen with an exaggerated expression of shock and amusement while facing the camera. (2) The scene cuts to a full-screen vertical old photograph of the same woman when she was younger, dressed in a red traditional Chinese-style top with black embroidered trim, smiling broadly and waving with pigtails. (3) Returning to the present, she interacts with her phone, making self-deprecating facial expressions—rolling her eyes and grimacing—as she begins her explanation. (4) Another old photograph appears showing her with short black hair and a white t-shirt, leaning on her arm in a park-like setting; she looks directly at the camera with a noticeable grin. (5) Back to live footage, she gestures towards her mouth, pointing at her teeth to explain their previous alignment, using her hands to mimic the shape of her jaw and teeth. (6) A close-up zoom of the previous outdoor photo focuses intensely on her teeth, highlighting irregularities. (7) She demonstrates a "bite" motion with her hands and fingers, explaining the overlap of her teeth with high energy and varied facial expressions. (8) Blue animated tear overlays appear on her cheeks as she mock-cries, looking regretfully at the camera. (9) She presses her palms together in a pleading gesture as cartoon dollar bills and money icons float around her, signaling a discussion about cost. (10) A fourth old photo shows her as a teenager wearing metal dental braces, smiling brightly at the camera. (11) She continues her high-energy monologue, using sweeping hand gestures to compare prices, with a cartoon thought bubble containing money signs and exclamation marks appearing near her head. (12) She holds up a large, white rectangular Zenyum box with blue branding, looking proud and excited. (13) A screen recording sequence displays the Zenyum mobile website, showing tiered pricing plans, treatment durations (3-9 months, 9-15 months, 15-22 months), and large numerical costs. (14) She rests her chin on the product box, giving a cheerful thumbs-up to the viewer. (15) She holds a small, round teal plastic case, opening it to reveal clear, transparent aligners. (16) She fans out several white paper packets containing dental aligners, demonstrating the complete set. (17) Another screen recording shows the step-by-step app process: answering questions about age and dental issues, followed by a grid of tooth photos and a side profile photo. (18) A final screen recording displays a "Thank You" booking confirmation page with a line chart showing a treatment plan. (19) She returns to the main frame, pointing at her screen and gesturing towards the description box below, ending with a wave and a wide, confident smile while holding the teal case.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 蘇珊黑歷史大公開. (2) [Subtitle]: 你相信我以前長這樣嗎!!. (3) [Variety]: 哎喲. [Subtitle]: 看到自己以前的樣子... 再給大家看一張. (4) [Subtitle]: 以前我的牙齒是往內暴的. 我不曉得大家對往內暴有什麼概念. (5) [Subtitle]: 如果往外暴的話就是像牙叉梳那樣. 但是我是往內暴的. (6) [Subtitle]: 門牙長在裡面. 兩顆虎牙卡在門牙外面. (7) [Subtitle]: 所以我每次笑起來都是... 其實是沒有門牙. (8) [Variety]: 嗚嗚... [Subtitle]: 那時候我拍照都特別的醜, 真的很困擾. (9) [Subtitle]: 所以那時候大學有在打工. 打工存到了一些錢錢, 我第一件事情去做的就是想要矯正牙齒. (10) [Subtitle]: 但是呢, 我去諮詢之後發現要戴傳統鋼牙, 而且要戴好久, 然後拍照又覺得很醜. *迫於現實還是戴了*. (11) [Subtitle]: 重點是每一間去諮詢的那個牙套的價格都不一樣. (12) [Subtitle]: 所以這時候就很猶豫. 大家應該都跟我一樣吧. (13) [Subtitle]: 怕戴牙套很痛, 講話又會大舌頭, 更怕價格是一個... 無底洞. (14) [Subtitle]: 不過如果你也有這些顧慮的話, 現在有新的選擇嘍. (15) [Logo]: zenyum. [Slogan]: 綻雅 Zenyum 隱形牙套!. (16) [Subtitle]: 哪一種 Zenyum 綻雅隱形牙套比較適合我呢?. [Subtitle]: 均一價格. (17) [Subtitle]: 不會因為你不同的診所, 就給你亂喊價. 這點真的超安心的. (18) [Subtitle]: 而且安全面也很重要. 綻雅呢是有通過衛福部醫療器材許可. (19) [Subtitle]: 還提供高達 1,000 萬產品責任險的品牌. (20) [Subtitle]: 再加上全程有專業牙醫的把關. 而且還可以先看到醫生設計的專屬治療計劃. (21) [Subtitle]: 全部都按照進度安排, 不是自己亂戴的哦. (22) [Subtitle]: 重點來了, 現在線上限初步預約完全免費. (23) [Subtitle]: 只要填寫基本資料以及拍4張牙齒的照片, 5分鐘就完成. (24) [Subtitle]: 先看自己適不適合戴牙套, 通過之後再預約到診所由專業醫師進一步檢查. (25) [Subtitle]: 現在還有限時的超殺優惠. 詳情我們都放在說明欄裡面了. (26) [Subtitle]: 想變美的話不要猶豫, 趕快點擊連結預約起來. 開啟你的綻雅 Zenyum 微笑之旅吧.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A woman with auburn/dark reddish hair in two braids, wearing a light pink hooded sweatshirt with a cartoon bear on the front.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Primary background is an indoor setting with wooden cabinets and a warm home atmosphere. Secondary backgrounds include an outdoor park/garden scene in old photos and digital interfaces of a website/app.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a high-pitched, energetic female voice speaking Mandarin at a rapid pace. Background music (BGM) is an upbeat electronic pop track with a prominent, driving synthesized beat. (2) A sharp 'click' sound effect mimics a camera shutter. (3) A 'whoosh' transition SFX signals a visual cut. (4) A comic 'boing' SFX emphasizes her point about her teeth alignment. (5) A brief laugh track SFX is layered underneath her narration. (6) A sobbing/crying cartoon SFX plays as she adopts a mock-sad tone. (7) A percussive 'ching' coin sound effect plays during the money discussion. (8) Successive 'ding' bell sounds punctuate her listing of dental pain points. (9) A 'shimmering' magic chime SFX introduces the product reveal. (10) The BGM remains consistent throughout the technical explanations, providing a positive energy floor. (11) Crinkling paper and plastic rustling sounds are clearly audible as she handles physical product samples. (12) High-frequency digital 'pop' UI sounds are synced with app movements. (13) The female voice increases in intensity and pitch for the final call to action, accompanied by a slight swell in music volume.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Pain Points -> Solution -> Brand Evidence -> Tutorial -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional endorsement for Zenyum invisible aligners. The creator uses personal story-telling by revealing 'ugly' past photos to build rapport and establish a need for dental correction. She then addresses common barriers to treatment (pain, cost, uncertainty) and presents Zenyum as a transparently priced, medically certified, and user-friendly solution, encouraging viewers to use their free online assessment.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of Zenyum branded box, detailed pricing, explanation of dental certification, and a step-by-step tutorial on using their assessment app with a specific CTA to click a link.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high production value social-media editing techniques, including frequent SFX and text overlays, to maintain high viewer engagement throughout the technical product explanation.
